notes.title: 3.1.0 Update
notes.content:
ADDED:
Updated in-game data for recent activity.
CHANGED:
Tutorial clarified: only unspent Manager Points carry between saves.
Updated translations.
FIXED:
Training no longer boosts declining players.
Partial fix: matches start even if some images don’t load.
Goalkeepers less slidey on dives.
Ball no longer sticks to hands.
Penalty shootouts display correctly.
Fixed some broken replays.

notes.title: Soccer Manager 2026 Out Now!
notes.content:
The day is here - the upgrade to[b] Soccer Manager 2026[/b] is now LIVE!


Unlike previous years, Soccer Manager 2026 is releasing as an update rather than a new game. This means you’re going to be able to keep all of your saves, gold, boosts, and everything else from year to year, with no need to start from scratch to enjoy the new content! We plan to support this for years to come, so you will be able to keep your saves from now into the future.

Making the move to a seamless game isn’t all we have worked on though. Soccer Manager 2026 also brings:

[list]
[*]A brand new objectives system, including the addition of daily objectives that can be progressed across all of your saves and plenty of brand new club-level objectives for you to work towards.
[*]An overhauled manager traits system, equipped with fully-featured perk trees that you can upgrade per-save and try out new builds with.
[*]An upgraded Match Motion engine, with new animations, lighting, and other overhauls that bring the best matchday experience yet to your fingertips.
[*]A redesigned UI, with a slick new colour scheme and improvements across the board to streamline the experience and make the game easier to play than ever before.
[*]Countless other improvements, including bugfixes and overhauls to key systems in the game to fix long-standing bugs and improve the user experience.
[/list]

Sound good? Download the update today and step into a new era for the Soccer Manager series!

notes.title: Update Notes for the 5th August
notes.content: General bug fixes and performance improvements

notes.title: Update Notes for the 23rd of June
notes.content:
This update is intended to resolve a couple of issues that came about with the release of the previous version - check out the list below:

FIXED
Resolved an issue where making all available substitutions in a quick match would cause the “Maximum number of substitutes will be exceeded” message to appear outside of matches.
Stamina & ratings bars will now update for your starting eleven as expected in matches.

KNOWN ISSUES
Players who are subbed on inherit the stamina & rating of who they replaced. A fix is planned for the next release.

We’d like to thank everyone who helped bring these issues to our attention so we could get them sorted. Your reports were useful in helping us find their causes.

Many Thanks,
Soccer Manager 2026 Team

notes.title: Update Notes from 2nd of June 2025
notes.content:
Many Improvements and Bug Fixes including:
Fixed a large number of issues with job vacancies.
Fixed an issue where stadiums could appear pink.
Fixed an issue that caused “please enter a valid value” to appear when creating your own club.
Fixed an issue where losing the second leg of a cup competition would lose the tie, even if you were ahead on aggregate.
Resolved a large number of issues with tactics & player roles.

notes.title: Update Notes: 17th March
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219969/3128271f40d2da072887f0840680d2da8305c60b.jpg[/img]

This update contains a number of bugfixes for issues that have been reported to us recently. We’ve also introduced the latest transfers that didn’t quite make it into the last update & re-introduced the game’s tutorial!

[h3]Update Notes: 17th March[/h3]
[list]
[*] New saves now include all latest transfers.
[*] New Basic tutorial was introduced.
[*] Training players are now sorted by rating progress.
[*] Double Training UI now displays correctly.
[*] International goals now show for the correct team.
[*] Road to Glory event numbers are fixed.
[*] National cup winners now qualify correctly.
[*] Scouting by attributes no longer resets.
[*] “Choose League” scouting works properly.
[*] Fixed infinite timer in penalty shootouts.
[*] International match reports no longer show all goals as away goals.
[/list]

A huge thanks to everyone who took the time to report issues to us! We’re very grateful for every report & we’re currently planning out future updates based on the reports you’re sending in. We’re also in the early stages of planning a community survey to help us identify areas to work on in the longer term - stay tuned for more news on that…

Invincibles Studio

notes.title: Update Notes: 22nd January
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219969/3128271f40d2da072887f0840680d2da8305c60b.jpg[/img]

This focuses on fixing some of the most commonly reported problems we have seen on Discord and through the in-game support portal. Big thanks to everyone who has reported these & answered any of our follow-up questions!

[h3]Update Notes: 22nd January[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Newsfeed Added: Stay updated with the latest in-game news and announcements.
[*] Increased prize money for continental competitions.
[*] Create-a-Club Fix: Objectives now display correctly.
[*] Loan Signing Fixed: Previously loaned-in players can now be signed.
[*] Smarter Player Requests: Unavailable players won’t request to play.
[*] Trophy Fixes: Resolved issues with some trophies not loading.
[*] Board Confidence Resolved: Fixed confidence drops when entering the screen.
[*] General Improvements: Bug fixes, UI tweaks, crash resolutions, and performance optimisations.
[/list]

We can’t overstate enough how important your feedback has been. Your reports help us find the causes of issues and prioritise which ones need fixing first, so please keep leaving your reports!

Invincibles Studio
